title: customcommands
description: User-defined commands per channel. Created via !addcmd, edited via !editcmd, removed via !delcmd.

channelId.description: Twitch user id of the channel this command belongs to

response.description: Reply template. Supports {user} and {1}..{N} positional argument tokens

createdByUserId.description: Twitch user id of whoever created the command
